info.title: VeryUE Quests Agent API
info.description: Local questline authoring API available while a Minecraft world/server is running. Default listener: 127.0.0.1:6700 (same listener as the editor). Mutations run on the game thread and share the editor's save lock, write datapack overrides, and reload quests before returning a revision. Send application/json for POST requests. Requests are limited to 1 MiB and 64 nesting levels. Configure vuequests.api.token to require bearer authentication on API routes; without it, no authentication is required. Revisions are optional for API writes. Validation is performed before persistence; disk/reload errors can leave overrides written. Use explicit UUIDs and read back state before retrying a timed-out creation.

servers.description: Default listener; vuequests.editor.host and vuequests.editor.port override the address.

post.description: Create an enabled section. Returns data.sectionId; name accepts native Minecraft text components.

post.summary: Create a quest in an available enabled section
post.description: Create a quest in an available enabled section. Defaults: position (0,0), title New quest, empty subtitle/description/tooltip and lists, book icon. Returns generated quest, objective and reward UUIDs.

post.summary: Create sections and quests together with one validation, save and reload
post.description: Create sections and quests together with one validation, save and reload. Supply at least one section or quest. Use client-generated UUIDs for sections and quests referenced by other entries. Quest dependencies may reference any quest in the batch, including later entries, or existing quests. Nested revision fields are ignored; use the top-level revision.
Require one quest before another. Cross-section dependencies are supported. Repeated edges succeed without duplication; missing prerequisites and cycles are rejected.

post.summary: Update one or more quest text fields
post.description: Update one or more quest text fields. Omitted/null fields are unchanged; supply at least one non-null text field. Use an empty string to clear text. Tooltip is plain text; title, subtitle and description use Minecraft components.
Append or replace objectives. Objective UUIDs are generated when omitted and returned in data.objectiveIds. Duplicate objective UUIDs across active quests fail validation.
Append or replace rewards. Reward UUIDs are generated when omitted and returned in data.rewardIds. Duplicate reward UUIDs across active quests fail validation.

post.summary: Change the quest icon using a loaded item registry ID
post.description: Change the quest icon using a loaded item registry ID.

post.summary: Move a quest on the quest canvas
post.description: Move a quest on the quest canvas. Both coordinates must be 32-bit integers.

get.summary: List all currently registered objective types and their authoring schemas
get.description: List all currently registered objective types and their authoring schemas. Built-ins provide complete metadata; external mods can register JsonSchema metadata alongside a codec. Codecs without metadata remain discoverable with schemaComplete=false and known field names.

get.summary: List all currently registered reward types and their authoring schemas
get.description: List all currently registered reward types and their authoring schemas. A schemaComplete=false entry exposes codec field names, without inferring field types or requiredness.

get.summary: List registries referenced by the built-in quest implementation: minecraft:item, minecraft:entity_type and minecraft:data_component_type
get.description: List registries referenced by the built-in quest implementation: minecraft:item, minecraft:entity_type and minecraft:data_component_type. Includes loaded sizes and usage. Data component value shapes remain native codec-defined.

get.summary: Read sections and their quests with the current document revision
get.description: Read sections and their quests with the current document revision. Sections requiring absent mods are omitted; disabled sections are included and cannot be edited through quest routes. Definitions use datapack snake_case field names.

get.summary: Read a quest and its native definition with the current document revision
get.description: Read a quest and its native definition with the current document revision.

get.summary: Read a quest's section and canvas X/Y coordinates with the current revision
get.description: Read a quest's section and canvas X/Y coordinates with the current revision.

get.summary: Search loaded registry IDs by namespace and/or path
get.description: Search loaded registry IDs by namespace and/or path. Matching uses case-insensitive substrings; filters are combined with AND. Omit both filters to browse all entries. Results are sorted by registry ID and paginated.

bearerAuth.description: Required only when the vuequests.api.token JVM property is configured.

Component.description: Minecraft 1.21.1 native text component, validated by ComponentSerialization.CODEC. Supports literal strings, component objects and component arrays, including translations, styles, click/hover events, score, selector, keybind and NBT components.

id.description: Loaded minecraft:item ID; air is not a valid stack.

components.description: Minecraft data component patch; validated by the registry-aware native ItemStack codec.

type.description: Registered objective type ID. Discover the current schema through /check/objectives.

entity.description: For vuequests:entity: a loaded minecraft:entity_type ID.

Objective.description: Dispatched to the registered objective codec. vuequests:collect_item requires item; vuequests:entity requires entity. Other mods can supply arbitrary codec fields.

type.description: Registered reward type ID. Discover the current schema through /check/rewards.

Reward.description: Dispatched to the registered reward codec. vuequests:item requires item; vuequests:experience requires experience. Other mods can supply arbitrary codec fields.

ListMode.description: append keeps existing entries; replace overwrites the list. An empty replacement clears the list.

sectionId.description: Optional client-generated UUID; an existing UUID returns 409.

revision.description: Optional optimistic concurrency token from the latest read/write response. A stale revision returns 409. Omission applies the change to the current document.

questId.description: Optional client-generated UUID; an existing UUID returns 409.

tooltip.description: Plain text. Omission defaults to an empty string.

revision.description: Optional optimistic concurrency token from the latest read/write response. A stale revision returns 409. Omission applies the change to the current document.

dependencyId.description: UUID of the prerequisite quest. Repeating an existing edge is a no-op. Both quests must be available; cycles are rejected before saving.

schema.description: Authoring schema registered with this codec. If metadata is absent, only codec field names are available.

schemaComplete.description: False when the codec has not registered schema metadata. Native codec validation still applies.

Error400.description: Invalid request or codec/graph validation failed; no data was saved.

Error401.description: Configured bearer token is missing or invalid.

Error404.description: Endpoint, section or quest not found.

Error405.description: Wrong HTTP method; Allow lists the supported methods.

Error409.description: Stale revision, duplicate creation UUID, unavailable section, or another save is in progress.

Error500.description: Persistence or reload failed; inspect the server log.

Error503.description: Timed out waiting for the game thread or reload. The write may finish after the HTTP response; inspect the document before retrying.
